review:
Supreme Zeus brings Hacksaw's Zeus back on a ways-to-win grid with its CoinWays mechanic. Gold Coin symbols add values of up to 10x to a Coin Bar when they are part of a CoinWays win.

Three or more FS symbols trigger the bonus game, and landing three Hot 100 symbols opens the Hot 100 bonus with 100 free spins, far longer than a normal Hacksaw feature. Hacksaw publishes 4/5 volatility, a 12,500x max win and RTP versions from 96.39% down to 86.32%. It suits players who like long bonus rounds.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.32% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
